vi.B: Chính hơi thở sự sống của chúng tôi, vị vua được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xức dầu, đã sa vào bẫy của chúng, \q là người mà chúng tôi đã từng nói: "Dưới sự che chở của người, chúng tôi sẽ sống giữa các dân tộc."
vi.R: Vị vua {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu quý giá với chúng tôi như hơi thở sự sống. Nhưng người đã sa vào bẫy của chúng. \q Chúng tôi từng nói: "Người sẽ che chở chúng tôi, và chúng tôi sẽ sống an toàn giữa các dân tộc."

sw.L: Pumzi ya pua zetu, mpakwa mafuta wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alikamatwa katika mashimo yao, \q [yeye] ambaye tulisema juu yake, "Chini ya kivuli chake tutaishi kati ya mataifa."
sw.B: Pumzi ya uhai wetu, mpakwa mafuta wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alinaswa katika mitego yao, \q yule ambaye tulikuwa tumesema juu yake, "Chini ya ulinzi wake tutaishi kati ya mataifa."
sw.R: Mfalme wetu, ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempaka mafuta, alikuwa wa thamani kwetu kama pumzi ya uhai. Lakini alinaswa katika mitego yao. \q Tulikuwa tumesema, "Atatulinda, nasi tutaishi salama kati ya mataifa."

ko.L: 우리 코의 숨, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 기름 부음 받은 이가 그들의 함정에 사로잡혔다. \q 우리가 그를 두고 "우리가 그의 그늘 아래에서 민족들 가운데 살 것이다" 하고 말하던 이였다.
ko.B: 우리 생명의 숨결과 같은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 기름 부음 받은 이가 그들의 덫에 걸렸다. \q 우리가 "그의 보호를 받으며 뭇 민족 가운데서 살 것이다" 하고 말하던 바로 그였다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기름 부어 세우신 우리 왕은 우리에게 생명의 숨결처럼 귀했다. 그런데 그가 그들의 덫에 걸렸다. \q 우리는 "그가 우리를 지켜 줄 것이니, 우리는 다른 민족들 가운데서도 안전하게 살 것이다" 하고 말했었다.

decisions.choice: the LORD's anointed was captured: King Zedekiah
decisions.reason: "The LORD's anointed" is the king of David's line (1 Samuel 24:7; Psalm 89:39). Jerusalem's last king, Zedekiah, fled the city by night and was captured near Jericho; the Babylonians killed his sons before his eyes, blinded him and took him to Babylon (2 Kings 25:4-7; Jeremiah 39:4-7).

decisions.choice: the breath of our nostrils: the one our life depended on
decisions.reason: Breath is life itself (Genesis 2:7). The king was the people's life, the one on whom their survival seemed to rest.

decisions.choice: their pits: hunters' traps
decisions.reason: Hunters dug pits to catch animals (Psalm 35:7; Jeremiah 18:22). Ezekiel pictures the kings of Judah as young lions caught in a pit and led away (Ezekiel 19:4, 8).

decisions.choice: in his shadow: under his protection
decisions.reason: Shade is protection from the burning sun, and so a picture of a ruler's protection (Judges 9:15; Isaiah 30:2; 32:2). The people had hoped to live safely under their king even among hostile nations.

decisions.choice: Our king, whom the LORD had anointed
decisions.reason: Readable says that the anointed one is the king.

decisions.choice: under his protection
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the shade stands for.

decisions.choice: "l’oint du SEIGNEUR", lowercase, with no deity_pronoun span on "lui", "son", "il"
decisions.reason: The anointed one here is the king of Judah (m1), not God, so his pronouns are ordinary French, as the English has no span on them.

decisions.choice: "el ungido", lowercase, no setting span
decisions.reason: The anointed here is the king of Judah, so the word stays lowercase and takes neither a christos nor a deity_pronoun span; "su sombra" and "él" refer to the king.

decisions.choice: "người được xức dầu của CHÚA" / "vị vua được CHÚA xức dầu" / "vị vua CHÚA đã xức dầu", with "người" lowercase and no deity span
decisions.reason: The anointed one here is Judah's king (the meaning decision names Zedekiah), so the wording is the one used for kings in Samuel, and no capital or deity span suggests the Messiah.

decisions.choice: "mpakwa mafuta wa BWANA", lowercase, with no deity_pronoun span on "chake"
decisions.reason: The anointed one here is Judah's king (Zedekiah), not the Messiah, so Swahili uses the plain description "mpakwa mafuta" rather than the title "Masihi", and his pronouns take no span.

decisions.choice: the LORD's anointed takes no -시-: "기름 부음 받은 이", "그"
decisions.reason: The anointed here is the captured king, a man, and the English gives him no deity span; Korean likewise speaks of him without the honorific, while the LORD who anointed him keeps it.

source.text: שִׂ֤ישִׂי וְשִׂמְחִי֙ בַּת־אֱד֔וֹם יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ ע֑וּץ גַּם־עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ תַּעֲבָר־כּ֔וֹס תִּשְׁכְּרִ֖י וְתִתְעָרִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, dwelling in [the] land of Uz; also to you will pass [the] cup; you will become drunk and make yourself naked.

en.L: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz; \q to you also the cup will pass; you will become drunk and strip yourself naked.
en.B: Rejoice and be glad, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz! \q But the cup will be passed to you as well; you will get drunk and strip yourself bare.
en.R: People of Edom, who live in the land of Uz, go ahead and celebrate now! \q But you too will have to drink from the cup of God's anger. You will get drunk and lie naked in shame.

fr.L: Réjouis-toi et sois dans l’allégresse, fille d’Édom, toi qui habites au pays d’Outs ; \q à toi aussi la coupe passera ; tu t’enivreras et tu te mettras à nu.
fr.B: Réjouis-toi, sois dans la joie, fille d’Édom, toi qui habites au pays d’Outs ! \q Mais la coupe te sera passée à toi aussi ; tu t’enivreras et tu te dénuderas.
fr.R: Peuple d’Édom, toi qui habites au pays d’Outs, vas-y, fais la fête maintenant ! \q Mais toi aussi, tu devras boire la coupe de la colère de Dieu. Tu seras ivre et tu te retrouveras nu, couvert de honte.

es.L: Gózate y alégrate, hija de Edom, que habitas en la tierra de Uz; \q también a ti pasará la copa; te embriagarás y te desnudarás.
es.B: ¡Gózate y alégrate, hija de Edom, tú que vives en la tierra de Uz! \q Pero también a ti te pasarán la copa; te emborracharás y quedarás desnuda.
es.R: Pueblo de Edom, que vives en la tierra de Uz, ¡celebra ahora si quieres! \q Pero también tú tendrás que beber de la copa del enojo de Dios. Te emborracharás y quedarás desnudo y avergonzado.

vi.L: Hãy vui mừng và hớn hở, hỡi con gái Ê-đôm, ngươi là kẻ ở trong xứ Út-xơ; \q chén cũng sẽ chuyền đến ngươi; ngươi sẽ say và lột trần mình.
vi.B: Hãy vui mừng hớn hở đi, hỡi con gái Ê-đôm, ngươi là kẻ sống trong xứ Út-xơ! \q Nhưng chén ấy cũng sẽ được trao cho ngươi; ngươi sẽ say khướt và tự lột trần mình.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Ê-đôm, những kẻ sống trong xứ Út-xơ, cứ ăn mừng bây giờ đi! \q Nhưng chính các ngươi cũng sẽ phải uống chén thịnh nộ của Đức Chúa Trời. Các ngươi sẽ say khướt và nằm trần truồng nhục nhã.

sw.L: Shangilia na ufurahi, binti Edomu, wewe ukaaye katika nchi ya Usi; \q kwako pia kikombe kitapita; utalewa na kujivua nguo uwe uchi.
sw.B: Shangilia na ufurahi, Binti Edomu, wewe unayeishi katika nchi ya Usi! \q Lakini kikombe kitapitishwa kwako pia; utalewa na kujivua nguo zote.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Edomu, mnaoishi katika nchi ya Usi, endeleeni kusherehekea sasa! \q Lakini ninyi pia mtalazimika kunywa kutoka kikombe cha hasira ya Mungu. Mtalewa na kulala uchi kwa aibu.

ko.L: 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라, 우스 땅에 사는 딸 에돔아. \q 그 잔이 너에게도 넘어갈 것이니, 네가 취하여 벌거벗을 것이다.
ko.B: 우스 땅에 사는 딸 에돔아, 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라! \q 그러나 그 잔이 너에게도 돌아갈 것이니, 너도 취하여 벌거벗게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 우스 땅에 사는 에돔 백성아, 지금은 실컷 즐거워하여라! \q 그러나 너희도 하나님의 분노의 잔을 마셔야 할 것이다. 너희도 취하여 벌거벗은 채 수치를 당할 것이다.

decisions.choice: rejoice and be glad: said in bitter irony
decisions.reason: Edom rejoiced at Jerusalem's fall and joined in plundering it (Psalm 137:7; Obadiah 10-14; Ezekiel 35:15). The command is mocking: let Edom enjoy it while it can, for its turn is coming.

decisions.choice: daughter of Edom ... the land of Uz: the people of Edom
decisions.reason: "Daughter Edom" pictures the nation as a woman, as "daughter Zion" does. Uz was a region east or southeast of Judah linked with Edom (Genesis 36:28; Jeremiah 25:20; Job 1:1). The reading the scribes marked (qere) has the usual form "who dwells"; the written consonants (ketiv) have an older form with the same meaning.

decisions.choice: the cup will pass to you: Edom too will drink God's anger
decisions.reason: The cup is the cup of the LORD's wrath, which makes the nations reel like drunkards (Jeremiah 25:15-29, where Edom and Uz are both named; 49:12; Isaiah 51:17). Drunkenness and nakedness picture helpless shame (Genesis 9:21; Habakkuk 2:15-16).

decisions.choice: the cup of God's anger
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cup is (m3).

decisions.choice: "le pays d’Outs"
decisions.reason: The form of the name already published in Genesis 10:23, 1 Chronicles 1:17 and Jeremiah 25:20.

decisions.choice: "hija de Edom" (L, B), "pueblo de Edom" (R)
decisions.reason: Edom is addressed as a woman, like Zion, with "tú" and feminine agreement at Literal and Balanced (desnuda); Readable names the people, as it does for Zion, and agrees with "pueblo".

decisions.choice: "con gái Ê-đôm" (Literal, Balanced); "dân Ê-đôm" (Readable); "xứ Út-xơ"
decisions.reason: The pattern of "con gái Si-ôn"; "Út-xơ" is the form already published in Jeremiah 25:20.

decisions.choice: "딸 에돔" (Literal, Balanced); "에돔 백성" (Readable); Uz is "우스"
decisions.reason: As the book's other daughter titles, with Readable naming the people and addressing them as "너희". Uz keeps the Protestant spelling of Genesis.

source.text: תַּם־עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְהַגְלוֹתֵ֑ךְ פָּקַ֤ד עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־אֱד֔וֹם גִּלָּ֖ה עַל־חַטֹּאתָֽיִךְ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Is finished your iniquity, daughter of Zion; not he will continue to exile you; he will punish your iniquity, daughter of Edom; he will uncover your sins.

en.L: Your iniquity is finished, daughter of Zion; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not continue to exile you; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will punish your iniquity, daughter of Edom; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will uncover your sins.
en.B: Your punishment is complete, Daughter Zion; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not keep you in exile any longer. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will punish your guilt, Daughter Edom; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will expose your sins.
en.R: People of Zion, your punishment is over. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not keep you in exile any longer. \q But people of Edom, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will punish you for your sin. He will show everyone your sins.

fr.L: Ta faute est achevée, fille de Sion ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne continuera pas à t’exiler ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} punira ta faute, fille d’Édom ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mettra à nu tes péchés.
fr.B: Ta punition est accomplie, fille de Sion ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne te gardera plus en exil. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} punira ta faute, fille d’Édom ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dévoilera tes péchés.
fr.R: Peuple de Sion, ta punition est terminée. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne te gardera plus en exil. \q Mais peuple d’Édom, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te punira pour ton péché. Il montrera à tous tes péchés.

es.L: Se ha cumplido tu iniquidad, hija de Sion; no volverá a desterrarte; \q castigará tu iniquidad, hija de Edom; descubrirá tus pecados.
es.B: Tu castigo se ha cumplido, hija de Sion; no te mantendrá más en el destierro. \q Pero castigará tu culpa, hija de Edom; dejará al descubierto tus pecados.
es.R: Pueblo de Sion, tu castigo ha terminado. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no te tendrá más tiempo en el destierro. \q Pero, pueblo de Edom, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te castigará por tu pecado. Hará que todos vean tus pecados.

vi.L: Sự gian ác của ngươi đã trọn, hỡi con gái Si-ôn; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không tiếp tục đày ngươi nữa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phạt sự gian ác của ngươi, hỡi con gái Ê-đôm; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phơi bày các tội lỗi của ngươi.
vi.B: Hình phạt của ngươi đã mãn, hỡi con gái Si-ôn; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bắt ngươi lưu đày lâu hơn nữa. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phạt tội lỗi của ngươi, hỡi con gái Ê-đôm; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phơi bày các tội của ngươi.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Si-ôn, hình phạt của các ngươi đã chấm dứt. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không để các ngươi bị lưu đày lâu hơn nữa. \q Nhưng hỡi dân Ê-đôm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phạt các ngươi vì tội lỗi của các ngươi. Ngài sẽ cho mọi người thấy tội lỗi của các ngươi.

sw.L: Uovu wako umekwisha, binti Sayuni; hatakupeleka tena uhamishoni; \q ataadhibu uovu wako, binti Edomu; atazifunua dhambi zako.
sw.B: Adhabu yako imetimia, Binti Sayuni; hatakuweka tena uhamishoni. \q Lakini ataiadhibu hatia yako, Binti Edomu; atazifichua dhambi zako.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Sayuni, adhabu yenu imekwisha. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawaweka tena uhamishoni. \q Lakini enyi watu wa Edomu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaadhibu kwa sababu ya dhambi yenu. Atawaonyesha watu wote dhambi zenu.

ko.L: 딸 시온아, 네 죄악이 끝났다. 그분께서 다시는 너를 포로로 끌려가게 하지 않으실 것이다. \q 딸 에돔아, 그분께서 네 죄악을 벌하시고 네 죄들을 드러내실 것이다.
ko.B: 딸 시온아, 네가 받을 벌이 다 끝났다. 그분께서 너를 더는 포로로 잡혀 있게 하지 않으실 것이다. \q 그러나 딸 에돔아, 그분께서 네 죄를 벌하시고 네 죄들을 드러내실 것이다.
ko.R: 시온 백성아, 너희가 받을 벌은 끝났다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 더는 포로로 붙잡혀 있게 하지 않으실 것이다. \q 그러나 에돔 백성아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희 죄를 벌하실 것이다. 너희 죄를 모든 사람 앞에 드러내실 것이다.

decisions.choice: your iniquity is finished: your punishment is complete
decisions.reason: The word ('awon) can mean a wrong or the punishment it brings (see verse 6). Said to Zion, with the end of exile, it means the punishment has run its course (compare Isaiah 40:2). Said to Edom, the same word is the guilt for which Edom will now be punished.

decisions.choice: he will not continue to exile you: your exile will not go on
alternatives: he will not exile you again
decisions.reason: "He" is the LORD, unnamed here. The phrase may mean that he will not prolong Zion's exile, or that he will never exile her again; both promise that the judgment is at an end.

decisions.choice: he will uncover your sins: Edom's guilt will be exposed
decisions.reason: The verb for uncovering (galah) is the same one used for sending into exile in the line before. Zion's exile ends; Edom's sins are laid bare, as one is stripped naked (verse 21).

decisions.choice: punishment (Zion); guilt (B), sin (R) (Edom)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense chosen in m1 for each use of 'awon; Literal keeps "iniquity" both times. Verse 6 explains the choice of "punishment".

decisions.choice: the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD, the unnamed "he" of both lines (m2).
